intents.title: Ship the new engine surface in the generated client
intents.statement: afwe init writes a client README and .gitignore that name the engine ledger, snapshots, rewind receipts and backups, and embeds the current TUTORIAL, SPEC, ubiquitous language and skill with ledger/snapshot/rewind sections.

intents.title: Start Studio and watcher from every turn begin
intents.statement: CLI turn begin, raw afwe call turn.begin and MCP afwe_turn_begin all call the same deterministic autostart path; no model decision is involved.

intents.title: Make autostart observable and project-scoped
intents.statement: Studio health reports its project root, so a daemon for another project is reported instead of silently reused. Spawn or readiness failures are printed and logged as studio_autostart_failed or watcher_autostart_failed, and AFWE_NO_AUTOSTART disables both.

intents.title: Test the generated scaffold
intents.statement: A unit test generates a client and asserts the README, TUTORIAL, SPEC, ubiquitous language, skill and .gitignore carry the new engine surface.
